# Burak Aksar

> CTO and co-founder with a PhD in machine learning systems. I build production AI end-to-end.

## Work

- [Spiky.ai](https://spiky.ai): CTO and co-founder. Building AI that finds the patterns behind successful sales conversations and helps representatives apply them live.
- IBM AI Research: Worked on explainable chatbot decisions and built a multi-intent parser that matched deep learning accuracy at 48 times the speed. The work produced two patents.
- Sandia National Laboratories: Built machine learning systems that detect performance problems in production supercomputers.
- Boston University: PhD in Computer Engineering focused on explainable machine learning for large-scale computing systems.
